nodes.title: 使用说明
widgets_values:
使用方法：
1. 主参考图：放角色正面/主外观图。
2. 三视图参考：放单张前/侧/背拼图；不想用时把“三视图强度”调 0。
3. 动作视频：放驱动视频；帧数=0 表示跟随完整视频。爆显存时改 41/49。
4. 运镜：用“运镜开关/强度/开始/结束”控制。强度建议 0.05~0.12。
5. 人脸捕捉：表情来自动作视频。真人建议 0.45~0.75；Q版/面具建议 0.20~0.40。
6. 先看骨骼时，启用“预览｜对齐前/对齐后”；正式生成可禁用预览省显存。
7. 5060Ti 16G：优先保持 416x736、41/49帧、BlockSwap 38~40。

nodes.title: 模型清单
widgets_values:
需要的常见模型文件：
- WAN2.2/Wan2_2-Animate-14B_fp8_scaled_e4m3fn_KJ_v2.safetensors
- Wan21_Uni3C_controlnet_fp16.safetensors
- wan_2.1_vae.safetensors
- clip_vision_h.safetensors
- umt5-xxl-enc-fp8_e4m3fn.safetensors
- sdpose_wholebody_fp16.safetensors
- vitpose-l-wholebody.onnx
- yolov10m.onnx
- lightx2v_I2V_14B_480p_cfg_step_distill_rank256_bf16.safetensors

模型路径以你的整合包目录为准；缺模型时先看 ComfyUI 控制台缺失文件名。

nodes.title: 提示词
widgets_values: a single character naturally follows the motion from the driving video, identity, outfit, visible body range, camera distance, and composition strictly follow the reference image, reference-image framing, stable body proportions, coherent motion, clean background, sharp details, empty hands, video face capture provides expression motion only, do not change identity or face shape,

full body forced from a half-body reference, zoomed-out tiny person, legs or feet appearing when the reference is half-body, cropped head, cropped feet for full-body reference, distorted legs, extra limbs, extra fingers, three legs, broken hands, identity drift, outfit drift, flicker, jitter, blurry, low quality, overexposed, oversaturated, subtitles, watermark, messy crowd background, object in hands, face capture changes identity, face shape drift, wrong face, expression overdrive,
